title: Sogaye ammu tere darya kinaare
body:
BETI SE APNE THE YE MAZLOOM KE NAALE
SOGAYE AMMU TERE DARIYA KE KINAARE
AAYA ALAM MASHQ MAGAR AAYA NA GHAZI
CHAAYI SAKEENA KE CHEHRE PE UDAASI
PAANI KA ARMAA NA RAKHO AB MERE PYAARE
KAISA MERA GHAR THA AUR KAISI THI SHAAHI
AAGAYI EK DOPAHAR ME KAISI TABAAHI
MILGAYE THE QAAK ME SAB MERE SAHAARE
AAG LAGEGI TERE DAAMAN KO AY DUQTAR
KAANON SE CHINJAAYENGE BIBI TERE GOHAR
DASHT ME TANHA TU BHALA KISKO PUKAARE
ZULM KA MEYAAR HAI AB HAD SE BHI BADKAR
PYAASON PE BHI REHAM NA KARTE HAI SITAMGAR
NAIZA MERE LAAL KE SEENE ME UTAARE
KAISA SAFAR THA WO MADEENE SE HAMAARA
BHAI BHATEEJON SE CHAMAN LAGTA THA PYAARA
AB NA NAZAR AAYENGE BETI WO NAZAARE
AAYENGE AMMU NA TUJHE PAANI PILAANE
HOGA NA KOI BHI TERE NAAZ UTHANE
JALNE KO MAGRIB ME HAI QAYAAM YE SAARE
JALTI ZAMEE TAPTI HAWAA MERI HAZEENA
SEHNA HAI UFTAAD BAHUT TUMKO SAKEENA
QAID ME GHUT GHUT KE TU DIN KAISE GUZAARE
BACHE TADAPTE RAHE PAR AAYA NA PAANI
KAUN BUJHAAYEGA BHALA TASHNADAHAANI
AB NA KARO MASHQ SE PAANI KE ISHARE
UMR BHAR HUSSAIN KO AAQA HI BULAAKAR
NARGAE AADA ME APNI SHAANE KATAAKAR
TANHA MUJHE CHODKE ABBAS SIDHAARE
KEHTI THI ZAINAB BHI WO BACHI SE LIPATKAR
KAISE BAYAA ALTHAF-O-NAQI HO YE MANZAR
KAUN NIGEHBAAN HAI PARDE KA HAMAARE
